Class HandlerMethodValidationException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.springframework.core.NestedRuntimeException
org.springframework.web.ErrorResponseException
org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
org.springframework.web.method.annotation.HandlerMethodValidationException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, MethodValidationResult, ErrorResponse
public class HandlerMethodValidationException extends ResponseStatusException implements MethodValidationResult
ResponseStatusException that is also MethodValidationResult. Raised by HandlerMethodValidator in case of method validation errors on a web controller method.

`ErrorResponseException.getStatusCode()` 对于输入验证错误返回 400，对于返回值上的验证错误返回 500。

Since:
6.1
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev

    • getDetailMessageArguments

      public Object[] getDetailMessageArguments(MessageSource messageSource, Locale locale)
      描述从接口复制：ErrorResponse
      Variant of ErrorResponse.getDetailMessageArguments() that uses the given MessageSource for resolving the message argument values.

      这对于例如从验证错误中扩展消息代码很有用。

      默认实现委托给ErrorResponse.getDetailMessageArguments()，忽略提供的MessageSource和Locale。

      Specified by:
      `getDetailMessageArguments` 接口 `ErrorResponse` 中
      Parameters:
      messageSource - 用于查找的 MessageSource
      locale - 用于查找的 Locale
